title: Arbitrary Brep Cut and Fuse in Kernel
description: UI freezes on heavy brep ops; computing nodes need animated rotating active border.
summary: Removed torus-specific boolean guards and SolidSource machinery from geometry/brep/rs. Boolean cut/fuse/intersect now routes through brepkit directly; when either operand has a torus surface, operands are copied and converted to NURBS via convert_to_bspline before boolean to avoid GFA hang on sphere+torus. Updated crate paths from geometry/brep/brepkit and infinite/canvas/vello to geometry/brep/rs and infinite/canvas/rs across workspace Cargo.toml files. Rebuilt flow/core WASM; sphere-cut-with-torus fixture eval completes in ~93ms with brep_bool_cut_5 producing solid-3. All 6 geometry_brep_brepkit tests, 6 flow_extension_brep tests, and 42 procedural/play tests pass.
